notes.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Ver 1.3.0 Update Details
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing [i]Urban Myth Dissolution Center[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’ve released Version 1.3.0 for the Steam version.[/p][p][/p][h1]■ Ver. 1.3.0 Update Details[/h1][h2]● New Features[/h2][h3]Select Chapter[/h3][p]You can now start the game from any chapter via the Select Chapter option on the title screen.[/p][previewyoutube="2LDxj4sbe_A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]* The Chapter Select feature becomes available after clearing the game.[/p][p]* If you cleared the game before updating to Ver. 1.3.0, you can access this feature by selecting “SET COMPLETION FLAG” from the options menu on the title screen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Adjust Character Movement Speed[/h3][p]You can now increase the character’s movement speed.[/p][previewyoutube="DGNTtIV4maU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Adjust Text Display Speed[/h3][p]You can freely adjust the speed at which text is displayed.[/p][previewyoutube="BUQB_-xo-UY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Auto Text Display[/h3][p]Text can now advance automatically without needing to click a button.[/p][previewyoutube="ZLYOnYqmH6M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Fast Forward Dialogue (Unlocked Post-Clear)[/h3][p]After completing the game, you can now skip dialogue at any time during subsequent playthroughs.[/p][previewyoutube="m38Y3GgsDVU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Carry Over Discovered Urban Myth & Database Entries[/h3][p]When starting a second playthrough, you can carry over the urban myths and database entries collected in your first run.[/p][previewyoutube="NfsV0_qIKJQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]● Minor bug fixes and text corrections[/h2][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you all for playing![/p][p][/p][p]The development team is working hard to make Urban Myth Dissolution Center even more enjoyable. We truly appreciate your continued support![/p]

notes.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Ver 1.0.3 Update Details
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Urban Myth Dissolution Center!

On April 15, 2025, at 1:00 PST we plan to release version 1.0.3 on Steam.

We appreciate your patience, and with this update, Steam Deck users will now be able to use cloud saves.

However, [b]if you usually play on a Steam Deck, please launch the game on your Steam Deck at least once after 1:00 PST on April 15 and trigger an auto-save before playing on another device.
[/b]If you start the game on another device before doing so, the save data on that device may overwrite the Steam Deck's save data. Please proceed with caution.

[h3]Changes in Ver 1.0.3[/h3]
・Bug fixes
・Typo corrections
・Fixed an issue where uncollected information was displayed in the notebook prematurely

Once again, we appreciate the love and support from everyone who has played the game!
Our development team is working hard to make Urban Myth Dissolution Center even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center All Gameplay Content Now Open For Streaming
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for playing and supporting Urban Myth Dissolution Center!

As of April 1st, 12:00 AM (JST), streaming and posting gameplay content from all chapters of the game is now fully open.

Thanks to your thoughtful support and spoiler mindfulness, many players were able to experience the game’s surprises as intended — and for that, we’re incredibly grateful.

[b]A Continued Request:[/b]
While you're now free to share content from the entire game, we kindly ask that you continue to be considerate of spoilers — especially when posting on public platforms like X (Twitter), YouTube, or TikTok.
[list]
[*] Please include a “Spoiler Warning” in the title or thumbnail if your content includes critical story scenes.
[*] For image posts of important scenes, please include a spoiler notice.
[/list]

You’re welcome to use the official spoiler warning assets available on our [official website and X (Twitter)] — feel free to use them!
Additional streaming materials, including the KV and logo, are also available at the following URL:
🔗 Download Here (Dropbox)
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/juj3jpq6mzt8qbt969is4/AMQtG6WzSlE4CXzHctFI17M?rlkey=vjsk1er4cork3vansh3tggggr&st=4js1hmq2&dl=0

Thank you for your continued support of Urban Myth Dissolution Center!

notes.title: "Urban Myth Dissolution Center" Future Improvement Plans
notes.content:
Thank you for playing *Urban Myth Dissolution Center*!

It has been a month since the release of *Urban Myth Dissolution Center*,

and we are truly surprised by the overwhelming response—far beyond our expectations!

We will be releasing detailed patch notes soon, but first, we would like to share our upcoming update plans.



[h2]■Planned Fixes by Early April[/h2]

[h3]①Bug Fixes[/h3]

Here are some of the currently identified bugs:

- In SNS investigations, the investigation cannot be completed even after collecting all necessary evidence
- Some sound effects (SE) may be excessively loud
- Some sound effects (SE) may continue playing indefinitely

[h3]②Fixing Typographical Errors

③Fixing an Issue Where Unobtained Information Appears in the Notebook Early[/h3]



[h2]■Planned Additions by Early June[/h2]

[h3]① Chapter Select Feature

② Adjustable Text Display Speed

③ Auto-Play Feature

④ Skip Read Text in Subsequent Playthroughs

⑤ Carry Over Obtained Urban Myths in Subsequent Playthroughs[/h3]



Please note that these improvements are subject to change.

Once again, thank you to everyone who has played this game!

Our development team is working hard to make *Urban Myth Dissolution Center* even better,

and we truly appreciate your continued support!
